verdict.rationale: Context.dev is a web-data API, and a starter-template library is a plausible ecosystem offering for such a product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only SDK install-and-scrape quickstarts, a CLI, an MCP server and an agent skill. None of these is a library of ready-made project templates, and an SDK quickstart is not a template library, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
